scope: Freeze the physical model, execution environment, acceptance metrics and resource rules before WP15-WP18 execution.

boundary_conditions.fixed_boundary: x=0 face, translations ux uy uz

loading.resultant_invariant: sum of nodal forces must equal total_force_n within 1e-12 relative

execution_environment.environment_match_policy: An execution on another profile must record its own environment and is not equivalent evidence.

solver_contract.seed_policy: No stochastic operation is used by the reference generator or solver; the declared seed is recorded for replay and any nonzero seed is separate evidence.
solver_contract.fallback_policy: none; unavailable or nonconforming backend is FAIL_CLOSED or RESOURCE_LIMITED, never an implicit fallback

spd_cg_contract.applicability: constrained homogeneous isotropic linear-elastic TET4 reference model only
spd_cg_contract.positive_definite_requirement: constrained free-free operator must be SPD; rigid modes or non-positive curvature reject CG qualification
spd_cg_contract.preconditioner_requirement: finite positive nodal blocks; singular blocks are an explicit failure
spd_cg_contract.diagnostic_policy: CG is not universal; unsupported symmetry/positive-definiteness must fail closed before qualification
spd_cg_contract.subscale_certificate: assembled operator may use a direct SPD diagnostic before comparison; no dense conversion at qualification scale

energy.observable: 0.5*u^T*K*u versus u^T*f for constrained linear system

displacement.observable: finite displacement vector and finite norm

matrix_free_assembled_subscale.comparison_rule: same generated input, same physical model and explicit backend metadata

replay_policy.numeric_comparison: record absolute and relative deltas; no unexplained drift is accepted
replay_policy.hardware_policy: same frozen profile for qualification; changed hardware is separate evidence

resource_safety.memory_rule: required free memory = ceil(1.25 * declared peak estimate); estimate and observed peak are both recorded
resource_safety.disk_rule: required free disk follows readiness estimator before model generation
resource_safety.oom_policy: STOP and RESOURCE_LIMITED; retain preflight and partial resource artifacts
resource_safety.timeout_policy: STOP and RESOURCE_LIMITED; no solve claim
resource_safety.partial_artifact_policy: write source/configuration/input/resource/status metadata even when solve is incomplete

bronze.claim_policy: Bronze alone is not a 3M solve claim

silver.backend: explicit matrix_free or PETSc, availability and choice recorded

gold.claim_policy: stretch; no Gold claim without all listed evidence

evidence_schema.digest_policy: canonical UTF-8 LF for text configuration; byte-for-byte SHA-256 for HDF5/binary input and result artifacts

wp_dependencies.WP15: uses this frozen model and subscale comparison contract; adds matrix-free SPD/preconditioner evidence
wp_dependencies.WP16: must satisfy the 1M_PASS contract; this WP14 record is not execution evidence
wp_dependencies.WP17: may provide PETSc/MPI backend; unavailable PETSc remains explicit
wp_dependencies.WP18: uses the declared Bronze/Silver/Gold ladder; Bronze cannot be relabeled as Silver
